name: Slab sniper
description: a small grey stone-skinned imp of the Cracked Road crouched behind a narrow upright stone slab with a slit, a long thin barrel of dark rock resting over the slab, one bright eye at the slit

poses.stand: crouched behind the narrow stone slab, barrel resting over the top, bright eye in the slit, facing right
poses.struck: struck: the slab chipping, the imp ducking
poses.dead: slab toppled and cracked, the imp sprawled behind it

idle.action: breathes and shifts in place, glow pulsing slowly

attack.action: performs its signature attack toward the right, glow flaring

hurt.action: is struck, jerks back, then settles

die.action: flares bright, breaks apart in a burst of embers and goes still
